summary: Strip the dead subsystems (GPU/shader render stack, terminal VOs, encode mode, screenshot, image writer, bitmap subtitles, default key bindings) from the audio-only build.
markersNote: Like 002-remove-libass, this patch's effect is DELETION, and absence has no string to grep for. It is asserted instead by size and by the artifact probes: the shipped .so must keep 55 exports (54 on darwin), all five rn-media markers, the 17 audio filters and 16 KB LOAD alignment while getting ~1.27 MiB smaller. AUDIO VARIANT ONLY, and that is load-bearing rather than cautious: the darwin fork also ships a VIDEO variant, and this patch removes the entire renderer that variant exists to use.
variantsNote: audio only. Applying this to darwin's video variant would remove vo_gpu/vo_gpu_next, render_backend_gpu and the whole video/out/gpu tree from a build whose reason to exist is exactly those files.
